theme.title: Broad Risk-Off
theme.summary: Energy (-0.52%) and Industrials (-0.55%) led the market today, while Financials (-1.84%) and Health Care (-1.74%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -1.01%, defensives -1.49%, and value/cyclicals -1.17% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -1.07%, Dow -1.68%, Nasdaq -0.77% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.51%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 11.28% to 25.46, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.80% to $3,807.50, crude oil was little changed at $85.07, and bitcoin slipped 0.91% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
